name: claude-patterns
description: Production-tested software patterns, agents, skills and hooks for Claude Code projects

scripts.validate: npm run validate:agents && npm run validate:commands && npm run validate:skills && npm run validate:rules && npm run validate:hooks && npm run validate:business-rules && npm run validate:metadata && npm run validate:counts
scripts.lint:shell: bash -c 'fail=0; for f in $(git ls-files "*.sh"); do bash -n "$f" || fail=1; done; exit $fail'
scripts.lint:json: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');let f=0;for(const p of execSync('git ls-files \"*.json\"').toString().trim().split('\n')){if(!p||p.includes('package-lock'))continue;try{JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(p,'utf8'))}catch(e){console.error('Invalid JSON: '+p+' — '+e.message);f=1}}process.exit(f)"
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run lint:shell && npm run lint:json
